project_context.theme_preference: Sleek Dark Mode default (Deep Slate) or Crisp Light Mode (Slate 50), with high-density functional design.

typography.strategy: Old Money Tech / Corporate SaaS - Authoritative headings paired with a sterile, highly legible mono/sans body optimized for tabular data and Indian numbering formats.

fonts.mono: IBM Plex Mono (for invoice numbers, UTRs, GSTINs, and currency amounts)

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Numbers in tables (rates, GST, totals) MUST use tabular-nums or IBM Plex Mono.
Line height: leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body.
Use Azure Blue (#2563EB) for primary actions and highlights.
Use Light Accent (#38BDF8) for subtle highlights, hover states, or progress bars.
No full-screen gradients. Use solid colors with 1px borders.
Status colors must be used consistently for Paid/Pending/Partially Paid badges.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton with crisp 1px borders (border-slate-200 in light, border-slate-800 in dark) to separate widgets.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px borders for definition rather than soft shadows. If using shadow, use shadow-sm.
visual_enhancers.borders: Subtle roundness (max 8px border-radius, i.e., rounded-md or rounded-lg).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Not recommended for main dashboard areas to maintain clarity, but can be used for sticky headers (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 or bg-slate-900/80 with 1px bottom border).

grids_and_layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics). Every pixel must be utilized. Data correlation and scanability are paramount.

bento_protocol.summary_cards: col-span-1 (Single metrics: Revenue, CGST, SGST, IGST, Outstanding)
bento_protocol.primary_data: col-span-2 row-span-2 or col-span-3 (Main invoice table or Account Reconciliation view)

spacing: Generous padding for outer containers (p-6 or p-8).
Tight padding for dense tabular data (p-3 or p-4).
Cardless or strict rectangular grid structures.
invoice_templates: GeM/Govt Supply: Strict tabular, highly formal, left-aligned text, right-aligned numbers.
Modern Corporate: Azure blue headers, clean grid, subtle branding.
Compact Single-Page: High density, minimal padding, optimized for A4 printing.

libraries: recharts for financial trend charts (if any)
html2pdf.js or jspdf/jspdf-autotable for PDF generation
rules: Use Shadcn UI for standard inputs, selects, dialogs, dropdowns, and tables.
Customize Shadcn components to remove the 'default Vercel look'. Use Azure Blue as the primary ring color.
Invoice table: Sticky headers, text left, numbers right, Indian numbering format (Lakhs/Crores) with 2 decimal places.
Do NOT use native <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn equivalents.

interactions: Hover states on table rows (bg-slate-50 / bg-slate-800/50).
Subtle button lift (-translate-y-[1px]) or background color shift on hover.
Smooth entrance animations for summary cards (staggered fade-in).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Light text on Azure Blue must be white.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='create-invoice-button').

login_hero.description: Modern glass building against a blue sky, used for login page split-screen background.

rules: Never use placeholder URLs. Use provided image URLs.
For empty states, use Lucide icons with subtle background circles (e.g., a FileText icon inside an Azure Blue transparent circle).

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a robust JWT-based Auth context with role-based routing (Admin/Staff).
The GST Calculation engine must correctly apply intra-state (CGST 9% + SGST 9%) for '24' GSTINs, and inter-state (IGST 18%) otherwise, based on the selected brackets (0/5/12/18/28%).
Use standard Indian numbering system (e.g., 1,00,000.00) using Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).
Ensure the PDF generation creates an A4 sized document, strictly adhering to the selected template layout.
Do not allow delete/edit on finalized invoices. Implement a status transition logic (Draft -> Finalized -> Partially Paid / Paid).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use them as solid backgrounds.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Never use AI assistant emojis (🤖🧠💭) for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable for outer containers, but keep tabular data dense.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
